# `⍸` — Where / Interval index

`⍸Y` lists exact positions, repeated according to their nonnegative integer counts. Higher-rank arguments give coordinate vectors.

```apl
⍸0 2 0 1           ⍝ 2ₓ 2ₓ 4ₓ
```

`X⍸Y` counts sorted boundaries in `X` ≤ each query. Uses [structural ordering](../rules.qmd#equality-and-ordering), without tolerance.

```apl
10 20 30⍸5 10 25 40 ⍝ 0ₓ 1ₓ 2ₓ 3ₓ
1 3⍸2              ⍝ 1ₓ
1 3⍸⊂2             ⍝ 1ₓ
1 3⍸,2             ⍝ ,1ₓ
```

Query cells and batch axes follow [Index Of](iota.qmd).
